meaning:
Pirathon = "princely"
a town in Ephraim in the mount of the Amalekite
perhaps modern 'Ferata' located 1.5 miles (2.5 km) south from Jaffa on the road to Nablus
Also named: pir.a.to.ni (פִּרְעָתוֹנִי "Pirathon" H6553)

elsewhere.note: Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
